dedupe_keys.name: seaward expansion of seaport footprints worldwide 1990 to 2020

description: This dataset contains the data and code for "Rapid seaward expansion of seaport footprints worldwide" (Sengupta and Lazarus, 2023, Communications Earth and Environment). It provides annual time series of seaward expansion through coastal reclamation, in square kilometres, from 1990 to 2020 for 65 of the world's 100 largest container ports in 2020 by reported throughput, with year, port, country, region and reclaimed area; a series from 2011 to 2020 that adds container throughput in million TEU for 43 of those ports, collated from archived Lloyd's List reports; a totals table; a list of excluded ports; and a Jupyter notebook. Coverage is global, for major container ports. Access: free CSV, XLSX and notebook files on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0, updated in November 2023, with earlier versions. Caveats: only 65 of the top 100 ports are measured, throughput figures come from trade press, and reclaimed area does not describe asset type. It supports analysis of port growth and exposure of reclaimed land to sea-level rise and storms, and port capacity planning, and complements the port multi-hazard risk dataset catalogued here.
name: Seaward expansion of seaport footprints worldwide, 1990 to 2020
provider: Plymouth Marine Laboratory and University of Southampton (Sengupta and Lazarus)
